row.evidence: Miradore documents no SCIM endpoint; its Premium+ plan adds Entra ID and Google Workspace integrations that sync users into Miradore, but "user deletion is not supported."
row.notes: Priced per managed device (Free up to 50 devices; Premium $2.75 and Premium+ $3.95 per device/month billed annually), so per-user fields are null. No SAML/OIDC SSO with the customer's own IdP: admins can 'Sign in with Microsoft' work or school accounts, which does not count as SSO. Vendor-run Entra ID / Google Workspace user sync (Premium+) creates and updates device users only, no deletion. REST API v2 (Premium and up) has user CRUD for device users. Product now sold as LogMeIn Miradore.

plans.price_text: Free, up to 50 devices after 14-day trial

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Priced per managed device, not per user. Pricing table shows API ticked from Premium (read from page markup).

plans.name: Premium+
plans.notes: Adds Entra ID and Google Workspace user-sync integrations and remote support.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint found in the pricing page, knowledge base sitemap (~1,170 URLs), or the API v2 Swagger spec. Device users come in through vendor-run Entra ID / Google Workspace sync (Premium+), CSV import or the REST API.

endpoints.purpose: Create, update and delete users in a batch

limitations.text: Miradore 'users' are device users (people devices are assigned to); console admins (Admin/Editor/Reader) are managed separately on System > Permissions and have no documented API.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/miradore/ returned 404; treated as not listed.

entra.notes: Miradore-run Entra ID user sync (Premium+); 'Sign in with Microsoft' work/school accounts for console login. No Entra gallery SAML or SCIM app found (Learn tutorial URL 404).

fallbacks.other_sync: Vendor-run Entra ID and Google Workspace device-user sync (Premium+, create/update only, no deletion); on-prem Active Directory import also listed.
